description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Lean adult man with narrow waist and natural shoulders, pale angular youthful face, ORANGE amber eyes and a soft knowing smile. Thick tousled dark BROWN hair side-parted, long curved curtain strands over forehead and eyes. Light warm GRAY suit jacket worn open and matching trousers, white shirt with OPEN collar, LOOSE dark brown tie, black belt. No mask or glasses. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 212-224px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY native standing scale, pixel rendering and strict front pose. Keep target original hair, eye color, face, body, clothing and colors. Do not copy identity or sunglasses.
